select gc.common_name,gc.common_image,gc.cat_name,gdpr.supply_common_id as supplyCommonId from goods_dealer_putaway_record gdpr left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gdpr.supply_common_id = gc.common_id where gc.common_name is not null
and gc.common_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
group by gdpr.supply_common_id
select count(1) from goods_dealer_putaway_record where supply_common_id = #{supplyCommonId}
